## Code provenance

Apply exactly one label before merging:

- `generated:claude` — mostly generated by Claude; Codex reviews it
- `generated:codex` — mostly generated by Codex; Claude reviews it
- `generated:human-or-mixed` — primarily human-authored or materially mixed; Codex reviews it

Every pull request is reviewed by one of the two agents. The label chooses which one —
it does not exempt a pull request from review.

The required `cross-agent-review` check rejects missing or conflicting labels, and
rejects `generated:codex` on commits carrying Claude co-authorship trailers, since that
would route Claude's own changes to Claude for review.
